##### Project general facts

Chelsea Residences Tower C by DAMAC Properties represents a groundbreaking collaboration with iconic football club Chelsea F.C., bringing the club's passion, prowess, and dedication to perfection to the shores of Dubai for the first time ever. Positioned at the most coveted point within the masterplan, Tower C captures sweeping sea views while affording residents true privacy, representing the collection at its most refined. This is the final opportunity to take your place within a legacy that was always building towards this moment, where ambition meets mastery in every detail.

The development offers an extraordinary array of amenities inspired by the natural, aquatic, and athletic worlds, including a vibrant coral reef aquascape where residents can swim or float on above-water swings. Wellness facilities cater to every whim with spaces infused with rituals of sky, land, and sea, while the Chelsea Sunset Bar, Tranquillity Falls, and water treatment tunnel provide unparalleled experiences without leaving home. Residents can also enjoy a gourmet healthy fine-dining restaurant, a Monotrophic Diet Café, and unmatched match-day experiences that celebrate the beautiful game.

Each residence features intelligently designed layouts with unobstructed panoramic views complemented by biophilic design, creating vibrant urban sanctuaries appointed with everything one could desire. The thoughtfully crafted living spaces include open kitchens and luxurious walk-in closets, maximizing space, natural light, and comfort. The interiors draw on the very best of contemporary aesthetics, elevating every aspect of daily living with refined elegance and sophisticated style.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Dubai Maritime City, a neighbourhood that embodies Dubai's heritage and its vision for the future realised every single day. The area offers a comprehensive range of services and infrastructure that support maritime industry, creating a unique and innovative community in the heart of Dubai. The strategic positioning provides seamless connectivity to major transportation hubs, business districts, and iconic destinations.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to Dubai's ports, connecting the area to global trade routes and facilitating seamless movement of goods and services. Residents enjoy convenient access to Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and beautiful Jumeirah Beach, making it an ideal address for those seeking both connectivity and waterfront living. The neighbourhood's unique maritime character creates a distinctive and vibrant atmosphere.

This extraordinary destination represents the perfect fusion of maritime heritage, strategic connectivity, and prestigious waterfront living. The area's unique combination of industrial vitality and residential refinement makes it one of Dubai's most distinctive addresses. This is a place where residents can enjoy the best of waterfront living — serene, connected, and effortlessly refined, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most dynamic communities.
